tagline.zh: 装饰图标一律 aria-hidden="true" 摘出无障碍树且永不落在可聚焦元素上;语义图标用可访问名写动作(「搜索」不是「放大镜」);四种 aria-hidden × 可访问名组合逐一对照读屏行为。
tagline.en: Decorative icons are removed from the accessibility tree with aria-hidden="true" and never sit on focusable elements; semantic icons get an accessible name describing the action ('search', not 'magnifying lens'); all four aria-hidden × name combinations compared against screen-reader behavior.

origin.zh: 规则主干来自 W3C/MDN 一手:MDN aria-hidden 明确可隐藏对象包含 "Purely decorative content, such as icons",且不得用于可聚焦元素;W3C WAI 功能图教程要求替代文本传达动作意图——"'print this page' rather than '(image of a) printer'"(out/design-study/07-icons.md §4.1)。WAI-APG 旧版 Images 实践页已于 2026-11 实测 404,现行由 names-and-descriptions 与 hiding-semantics 两页承接(07 §4.2)。
origin.en: The rule backbone is first-hand W3C/MDN: MDN's aria-hidden page lists "Purely decorative content, such as icons" among hideable objects and forbids use on focusable elements; the W3C WAI functional-images tutorial requires alt text to convey intent — "'print this page' rather than '(image of a) printer'" (out/design-study/07-icons.md §4.1). The old WAI-APG Images practice pages measured 404 in 2026-11, succeeded by the names-and-descriptions and hiding-semantics pages (07 §4.2).

effect.zh: 装饰化开关。默认 on:图标被摘出无障碍树(MDN:aria-hidden="true" removes the element and all children from the accessibility tree),按钮只播报可访问名——MDN 官方示例即此分工(图标装饰 + 按钮拿名)。红线:aria-hidden 不得用在可聚焦元素或其祖先上(焦点会落进被隐藏子树);本 demo 的 aria-hidden 始终在 svg 上、按钮可聚焦不受影响(07 §4.1)。
effect.en: Decorative switch. Default on: the icon leaves the accessibility tree (MDN: aria-hidden="true" removes the element and all children from it) and the button announces only its accessible name — the MDN example itself splits work this way (decorated icon + named button). Red line: never put aria-hidden on a focusable element or its ancestor (focus would land inside a hidden subtree); here aria-hidden always sits on the svg while the button stays focusable (07 §4.1).

effect.zh: 可访问名开关。默认 with:纯图标按钮必须有可访问名,且写动作不写形状——WAI 教程原文 "'search' rather than 'magnifying lens'","print this page" 而非 "printer"(07 §4.1);demo 取「收藏」而非「星形」。without 档展示失败形态:按钮无可访问名,读屏只能读到「按钮」,信息全失;针对 缺 alt 时读屏会朗读文件名/URL(内联 SVG 行为因读屏器实现而异,未统一规定)。
effect.en: Accessible-name switch. Default with: an icon-only button must carry a name describing the action, not the shape — WAI tutorial wording "'search' rather than 'magnifying lens'", "print this page" not "printer" (07 §4.1); the demo names it 「收藏」 (favorite), never 「star shape」. The without option shows the failure: an unnamed button reads just “button”, losing all information; for without alt, screen readers may announce the file name/URL (inline SVG behavior varies by reader implementation, not standardized).

note.zh: aria-hidden 与 aria-label 是 ARIA 标准属性,现代浏览器 + 主流读屏器(NVDA/JAWS/VoiceOver/Narrator)均支持;读屏器对无 title 内联 SVG 的具体播报行为存在实现差异(未统一规定),demo 的「读屏模拟」按 W3C/MDN 规则推演,不宣称逐字复刻任一读屏器。
note.en: aria-hidden and aria-label are standard ARIA attributes supported by modern browsers and major screen readers (NVDA/JAWS/VoiceOver/Narrator); how a given reader treats untitled inline SVG varies by implementation (not standardized) — the demo's simulation follows W3C/MDN rules and does not claim to replicate any specific reader verbatim.

fallback.zh: ARIA 属性在极旧 AT 上可能被忽略,因此可访问名优先用**平台原生机制**:按钮内有真实文字(可见标签)> aria-label;装饰图标在无 ARIA 环境下退化为「多读一段无意义内容」,不破坏功能——这也是 MDN 示例保留文字标签的原因。
fallback.en: Very old assistive tech may ignore ARIA, so prefer native mechanisms for names: real text inside the button (visible label) beats aria-label; without ARIA a decorative icon degrades to one extra meaningless utterance and never breaks function — which is why MDN's example keeps the text label.

use.zh: 图标 + 文字按钮:图标纯装饰 aria-hidden,文字就是可访问名(MDN 官方示例分工)
use.en: Icon + text button: icon purely decorative with aria-hidden, the text is the accessible name (MDN's canonical split)

use.zh: 纯图标按钮(工具栏):图标 aria-hidden + 按钮拿 aria-label 写动作「收藏/搜索/打印此页」
use.en: Icon-only buttons (toolbars): icon aria-hidden + aria-label on the button stating the action (favorite / search / print this page)

use.zh: 信息型共享图标(如「新窗口」):替代文本承载图标语义本身(07 §4.1 例 3)
use.en: Shared informational icons (e.g. new window): the alt text carries the icon's meaning itself (07 §4.1 example 3)

avoid.zh: aria-hidden 放在可聚焦元素或其祖先上——焦点落进隐藏子树是 ARIA 红线(MDN 原文,07 §4.1)
avoid.en: aria-hidden on a focusable element or its ancestor — focus landing inside a hidden subtree is an ARIA red line (MDN, 07 §4.1)

avoid.zh: 用形状描述当可访问名(「五角星」「放大镜」)——应写动作(「收藏」「搜索」,WAI 教程,07 §4.1)
avoid.en: Naming by shape ('star', 'magnifier') instead of by action ('favorite', 'search') — WAI tutorial, 07 §4.1

avoid.zh: 隐藏后没有等价信息暴露("identical or equivalent meaning and functionality" 是摘除前提,07 §4.1)
avoid.en: Hiding without equivalent information exposed — 'identical or equivalent meaning and functionality' is the precondition for removal (07 §4.1)

a11y.zh: 本条目即无障碍本体:装饰图标 aria-hidden 摘树;图标按钮可访问名写动作;摘除前提是等价信息已从其他通道暴露。另两条相邻护栏:图形对比 ≥3:1(WCAG 1.4.11,见 icon-color-states)、焦点指示同样受 3:1 约束。读屏行为对照表以 W3C/MDN 规则推演,实际播报因读屏器而异(已如实标注)。
a11y.en: This entry IS the accessibility content: decorative icons leave the tree via aria-hidden; icon buttons get action-named accessible names; removal presumes equivalent information is exposed elsewhere. Adjacent guardrails: ≥3:1 non-text contrast (WCAG 1.4.11, see icon-color-states) and focus indicators bound by the same 3:1. The behavior table is a rule-based simulation; actual utterances vary by screen reader (marked honestly).

goal.zh: 实现一个无障碍图标按钮:装饰图标 aria-hidden="true",按钮携带写动作的可访问名,并给出图标+文字变体;四种 aria 组合的读屏行为对照表随实现交付。
goal.en: Build an accessible icon button: decorative icon with aria-hidden="true", an action-stating accessible name on the button, plus an icon+text variant; deliver the four-combination screen-reader behavior table with the implementation.

acceptance.zh: 装饰图标一律 aria-hidden="true",且永不落在可聚焦元素或其祖先上
acceptance.en: Decorative icons always carry aria-hidden="true" and never sit on a focusable element or its ancestor

acceptance.zh: 纯图标按钮可访问名写动作(「收藏」),不写形状(「星形」)
acceptance.en: Icon-only buttons name the action (favorite), never the shape (star)

acceptance.zh: 图标+文字按钮中,可见文字即唯一可访问名来源,图标摘除不冗余
acceptance.en: In icon+text buttons the visible text is the sole name source; the icon is removed without duplication

acceptance.zh: 不为 aria-hidden 元素保留焦点、交互或任何仅靠视觉传递的关键信息
acceptance.en: No focus, interactivity or visually-only key information remains inside aria-hidden subtrees

acceptance.zh: 实现附读屏行为对照(装饰/保留 × 有名/无名四格),注明为规则推演而非逐字读屏输出
acceptance.en: Ship the four-cell behavior table (decorative/kept × named/unnamed), noted as rule-based simulation rather than verbatim reader output
